items.prompt: For Q=5 and weights [1,2], what exact remainder comparison selects the extra?

options.why: Rounding quotas first can erase the exact ranking; no float conversion is needed.

options.text: Compare remainders 2 and 1 over common denominator 3.
options.why: The bases are 1 and 3; bucket 0 has the larger fractional remainder and receives the extra.

options.text: Compare raw weights 1 and 2, so bucket 1 wins.
options.why: The largest weight need not have the largest fractional remainder.

options.text: Compare bucket indexes only, regardless of remainders.
options.why: Index is a tiebreaker after exact remainder rank, not the primary criterion.

items.explanation: The bases are 1 and 3; bucket 0 has the larger fractional remainder and receives the extra.
